# Example: Nested Loop

#### Course: Learn Java Basics

## Example: Nested Loop

Let's slightly modify the program we previously wrote.

```java
1class Main {
2    public static void main(String[] args) {
3        
4        String[] features = {"Electric", "Fast"};
5        String[] cars = {"Tesla", "Porsche", "Mercedes"};
6
7        // Outer loop
8        for (int i = 0; i < features.length; ++i) {
9
10            // Inner loop
11            for (int j = 0; j < cars.length; ++j) {
12                System.out.println(features[i] + " " + cars[j]);
13            }
14            
15            System.out.println("----");
16        }
17    }
18}
```

Output

```text
Electric Tesla
Electric Porsche
Electric Mercedes
----
Fast Tesla
Fast Porsche
Fast Mercedes
----
```

In the program, the System.out.println("----"); statement is outside the inner loop because it's on the same level as the inner for loop.

![Inner loop and outer loop in a nested loop](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, for each iteration of the outer loop, this code is executed:

```java
for (int j = 0; j < cars.length; ++j) {
    System.out.println(features[i] + " " + cars[j]);
}
            
System.out.println("----");
```
